query:row_color_cell_count.answer_hint: Set answer to the requested row color count as an integer.
query:row_color_cell_count.annotation_hint: Set annotation to a bbox_set: one image-pixel cell box [x0,y0,x1,y1] for each counted cell in the row; use [] if no cells match.

query:column_color_cell_count.answer_hint: Set answer to the requested column color count as an integer.
query:column_color_cell_count.annotation_hint: Set annotation to a bbox_set: one image-pixel cell box [x0,y0,x1,y1] for each counted cell in the column; use [] if no cells match.

query:edge_color_cell_count.answer_hint: Set answer to the requested border-cell color count as an integer.
query:edge_color_cell_count.annotation_hint: Set annotation to a bbox_set: one image-pixel cell box [x0,y0,x1,y1] for each counted border cell; use [] if no cells match.

query:largest_component_size.answer_hint: Set answer to the number of cells in the largest target-color component.
query:largest_component_size.annotation_hint: Set annotation to a bbox_set containing the image-pixel cell boxes in that largest connected component.

query:reachable_region_size.answer_hint: Set answer to the number of light passable cells reachable from S by side-adjacent moves, including S.
query:reachable_region_size.annotation_hint: Set annotation to a bbox_set containing the image-pixel cell boxes for all reachable passable cells, including S.

query:shortest_path_length_value.answer_hint: Set answer to the shortest path length in orthogonal cell steps.
query:shortest_path_length_value.annotation_hint: Set annotation to a segment_set: one image-pixel segment [[x1,y1],[x2,y2]] for each adjacent step along a shortest S-to-G path.

query:symmetry_violation_count.answer_hint: Set answer to the number of counted-side cells that fail the mirror check.
query:symmetry_violation_count.annotation_hint: Set annotation to a segment_set: one image-pixel segment [[x1,y1],[x2,y2]] from each counted-side violating cell center to its mirror-cell center.
